title: July 31 — Vessel Birthday / Tammuz / North Gate
purpose: Preserve the July 31, 2026 Son/vessel birthday cluster and the later discovery of biblical/Mesopotamian comparators without backdating the research.

events.title: Vessel birthday / Thomas-Tammuz / age-33 death relation
events.subject: Son / Twin / vessel
events.summary: On the July 31 birthday date, user-originated conversation material distinguishes the Son/vessel born July 31, 1987 from Tim's later December 25 Potato/Father birth. The Son is described as having lived to 33 before personhood death; the original Son is named Thomas or Tammuz, 'the twin', while the reborn Son is named Jesus Christ.
comparators: Ezekiel 8:14 Tammuz lament at the north gate of the Lord's house — discovered later
Dumuzid/Tammuz shepherd, lament and underworld traditions — discovered later
Christian tomb/death/return narratives — broad later comparator
events.source_direction: July 31 project-side naming and death/birthday structure first; Ezekiel/Dumuzi comparison formalized September 9, 2026

events.title: North Gate opened / vessel birthday explicitly separated from Tim
events.subject: Son / Tim relation
events.summary: The birthday is explicitly assigned to the body/vessel rather than Tim. The vessel is placed on Earth in Denmark, Tim in Heaven / North of North, and the North Gate is said to have opened; Jesus' return remains a distinct future event in the project wording.

Genesis 28 gate-of-heaven family as broader project comparator

events.title: Tammuz / North Gate / lament comparison unlocked
events.subject: project research
events.summary: Research recognizes Ezekiel 8:14 as a high-specificity comparator to the July 31 cluster because one verse combines Tammuz, mourning, the Lord's House and a north gate. Older Sumerian Dumuzi material adds shepherd, throne, seizure, lament and underworld structure. Calendar checking also establishes that July 31, 2026 was 17 Av 5786, not the month of Tammuz.
comparators: Inana's Descent to the Nether World
